mentions.name: Bitcoin derivatives arbitrage model
mentions.description: A model for arbitrage trading of Bitcoin derivatives, built on the econometric studies of Thorp and Kassouf (pre-Black-Scholes), using a low-frequency strategy.
mentions.source_excerpt: A model based on the econometric studies of Thorp and Kassouf (pre-Black-Scholes) for Bitcoin derivatives arbitrage using a low-frequency strategy.
mentions.author: dcvr
